sources.title: Integrative systematics of the Australian peacock spiders and their allies
sources.author: Joseph Schubert
sources.notes: Chapters III, IV and V are treated as source assertions within one thesis. The thesis states on PDF page 6 that names and nomenclatural acts proposed only in the thesis are not formally published under the ICZN. Chapter-level composition or relationship conflicts are therefore retained rather than silently reconciled.

concepts.notes: Chapter V recovers the Saitis group with UFBoot 100 and divides it into the Jotus and Maratus groups. Chapter V text is internally inconsistent about the number of included genera: prose refers to 13 and approximately 15, while the explicit list and male key contain 12.
Supported at UFBoot 100; explicitly comprises Jotus, Prostheclina, Tropijotus and Umbrattus.
Supported at UFBoot 100; explicitly includes Maratus, Striattus, Variattus, Saitis sensu stricto, cf. Maileus, Anablemum, Hypoblemum, Salinatus and Micromaratus.

included_taxa.name: Anablemum lithicum
included_taxa.notes: Proposed as the type species.

concepts.notes: Morphologically diagnosed and placed as the earliest-diverging lineage in the Anablemum-Hypoblemum-Salinatus-Micromaratus assemblage; only one Anablemum species was sampled molecularly.

included_taxa.name: Hypoblemum griseum
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

included_taxa.name: Saitis taeniatus
included_taxa.notes: Treated as a junior synonym of Hypoblemum griseum.

concepts.notes: Recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 99. The biological genus concept and the availability/effect of the thesis-only nomenclatural acts are kept separate.

included_taxa.name: Jotus auripes
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

concepts.notes: Chapter IV's explicit composition has 16 accepted species plus four incertae sedis. Chapter V's later synopsis lists only 10 accepted species and omits several Chapter IV additions or transfers, including J. remus and J. vittatus. The discrepancy is retained; this concept uses the fuller Chapter IV assertion and does not infer a silent exclusion. Jotus is recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 100.

included_taxa.name: Maratus amabilis
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

included_taxa.name: Maratus expolitus
included_taxa.notes: Listed under Maratus here, but transferred to Variattus on PDF page 251.

included_taxa.name: Maratus griseus
included_taxa.notes: Listed under Maratus here, but restored to Hypoblemum on PDF page 163.

included_taxa.name: Maratus scutulatus
included_taxa.notes: Listed under Maratus here, but restored to Hypoblemum on PDF page 163.

included_taxa.name: Maratus splendens
included_taxa.notes: Present as named terminals in the Chapter V phylogeny but absent from the explicit Maratus composition list on PDF pages 178–180; no curator inclusion or exclusion is inferred.

included_taxa.name: Maratus bitaeniatus
included_taxa.notes: Suggested as possibly belonging to Micromaratus, but not transferred.

included_taxa.name: Maratus heteropogon
included_taxa.notes: Suggested as possibly belonging to Jotus, but not transferred.

included_taxa.name: Maratus obscurior
included_taxa.notes: Suggested as possibly belonging to Jotus, but not transferred.

concepts.notes: Recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 100. The Chapter V composition list itself retains Maratus expolitus, M. griseus and M. scutulatus even though the same chapter transfers them to Variattus or Hypoblemum; those contradictions are marked at the individual assertions. Maratus splendens occurs in the phylogeny but not in that composition list.

included_taxa.name: Micromaratus nigromaculatus
included_taxa.notes: Proposed type species.

concepts.notes: Recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 100 and sister to Salinatus with UFBoot 100.

included_taxa.name: Prostheclina pallida
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

concepts.notes: Chapter V treats a sampled cf. Prostheclina lineage as a deep sister lineage to the remaining sampled Prostheclina and possibly an undescribed genus; it is represented separately as TC0023.

included_taxa.name: Saitis barbipes
included_taxa.notes: Type species and only Saitis species sampled in the Chapter V phylogeny.

concepts.notes: The thesis explicitly declines a full revision or formal rediagnosis of Saitis and restricts its working concept to the type species and two similar Mediterranean species. Male recognition characters are supplied, but not a comprehensive genus diagnosis.

included_taxa.name: Salinatus speculifer
included_taxa.notes: Proposed type species.

concepts.notes: Recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 100 and sister to Micromaratus with UFBoot 100.

included_taxa.name: Striattus exclamatus
included_taxa.notes: Proposed type species.

concepts.notes: Recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 99 and in a well-supported clade with Variattus (UFBoot 99).

included_taxa.name: Tropijotus fuchsia
included_taxa.notes: Proposed type species.

included_taxa.name: Tropijotus wondul
included_taxa.notes: Chapter III's composition line spells the epithet 'wondu'; figures and Chapter V use 'wondul'. The preferred source spelling here follows Chapter V, while the variant is retained in this note.

concepts.notes: Chapter III recovered Tropijotus as a strongly supported clade and described a relationship to Jotus plus Prostheclina. Chapter V's broader framework instead places Tropijotus as sister to Umbrattus, with UFBoot 100 for both. Both chapter assertions are retained in provenance rather than treated as identical topologies.

included_taxa.name: Umbrattus bimaculatus
included_taxa.notes: The composition line labels this as the type species, conflicting with the type-species statement on PDF page 239.

included_taxa.name: Umbrattus spectabilis
included_taxa.notes: The genus heading labels this as the type species, conflicting with the composition annotation on PDF page 240.

included_taxa.name: Saitis virgatus
included_taxa.notes: Treated as a junior synonym of Umbrattus bimaculatus.

concepts.notes: The thesis contains two incompatible explicit type-species assertions; no curator resolution is made. Recovered as sister to Tropijotus, with both clades UFBoot 100.

included_taxa.name: Variattus mutans
included_taxa.notes: Proposed type species.

concepts.notes: Recovered as monophyletic with UFBoot 100 and in a well-supported clade with Striattus (UFBoot 99).

included_taxa.name: Barraina anfracta
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

concepts.notes: Listed among genera requiring further consideration. Morphology suggests possible Saitis-group affinity, but no representative was included in the molecular phylogeny.

included_taxa.name: Frewena maculata
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

concepts.notes: Listed among genera requiring further consideration. Morphology suggests possible Saitis-group affinity, but no representative was included in the molecular phylogeny.

included_taxa.name: Lauharulla insulana
included_taxa.notes: No justification was found for its historical placement in Lauharulla.

included_taxa.name: Lauharulla pretiosa
included_taxa.notes: Type species; original description and figures are inadequate for confident identification.

concepts.notes: Discussed for consideration but not confidently included in the revised Saitis group; the genus may be unrelated.

type_species.name: Maileus fuscus
type_species.authorship: G. W. Peckham & E. G. Peckham

included_taxa.name: Maileus fuscus
included_taxa.notes: Type species; known only from the female type specimen in the thesis account.

included_taxa.name: Maileus obscurus
included_taxa.notes: Provisionally retained pending discovery or examination of a male and reassessment of generic placement.

concepts.notes: Maileus sensu stricto was not sampled. The phylogenetic terminal identified as cf. Maileus may not be congeneric and is represented separately as TC0022.

included_taxa.name: Margaromma funestum
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

included_taxa.name: Margaromma soligena
included_taxa.notes: Suggested as possibly belonging to Omoedus, but not transferred.

concepts.notes: Discussed for consideration but not confidently included in the revised Saitis group; the type species and genus limits require re-examination.

included_taxa.name: Salpesia soricina
included_taxa.notes: Type species.

included_taxa.name: Salpesia squalida
included_taxa.notes: Molecular evidence placed the sampled species as sister to Servaea rather than establishing membership in Salpesia sensu stricto.

concepts.notes: The type species is not Australian and is morphologically dissimilar to Australian species historically placed in Salpesia. Salpesia is discussed for consideration, not confidently included in the revised Saitis group. Salpesia bimaculata is separately transferred to the proposed Umbrattus concept.
The sampled terminal is the earliest-diverging lineage of the Maratus group in Chapter V (the relevant node is UFBoot 93), but it is explicitly not confidently equated with Maileus sensu stricto.
Recovered as a deep sister lineage to the remaining sampled Prostheclina with UFBoot 99; the thesis states it may represent an undescribed genus and does not force it into Prostheclina sensu stricto.

relationships.notes: Support value also reflects the recovered monophyly of sampled Jotus.

relationships.subject: TC0009

relationships.subject: TC0013

relationships.subject: TC0013

relationships.notes: Object denotes the remaining sampled Prostheclina lineage; the cf. terminal may be an undescribed genus.

relationships.subject: TC0023
relationships.notes: Not treated as confidently congeneric with Prostheclina sensu stricto.

relationships.notes: Earliest-diverging sampled lineage within the Maratus group; support applies to the relevant node, not to equivalence with Maileus.

relationships.subject: TC0022
relationships.notes: The cf. terminal may not represent Maileus sensu stricto.

relationships.subject: TC0010
relationships.notes: Poorly supported relationship based on the sampled Saitis barbipes lineage; not generalized to unsampled Saitis sensu lato.

relationships.subject: TC0012
relationships.notes: The thesis describes a relatively close, well-supported clade; predicate avoids over-resolving the precise sister topology.

relationships.subject: TC0004
relationships.notes: Anablemum is the earliest-diverging lineage in the Anablemum-Hypoblemum-Salinatus-Micromaratus assemblage, whose enclosing clade has UFBoot 93; the diagnosis also calls Hypoblemum its sister genus. The enclosing-clade value is not assigned to this non-binary relation.

relationships.subject: TC0016
relationships.notes: Candidate for consideration; not sampled molecularly.

relationships.subject: TC0017
relationships.notes: Candidate for consideration; not sampled molecularly.

relationships.subject: TC0018
relationships.notes: Genus may be unrelated to the Saitis group.

relationships.subject: TC0019
relationships.notes: Maileus sensu stricto was not sampled and is not equated with cf. Maileus sp.

relationships.subject: TC0020
relationships.notes: Generic limits and Saitis-group affinity require re-examination.

relationships.subject: TC0021
relationships.notes: Historical Australian Salpesia usages do not establish membership of the type-species-anchored Salpesia concept in the Saitis group.
